caseNameFull: Mildred McIntosh v. W. H. Dill
attorneys: Mr. Thomas H. Owen and Mr. George C. Crump for plaintiff in error. Mr. Nathan A:, Gibson and Mr. Joseph L. Hull for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as 'amended by the Act of September 6, 19.16, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6.
